title.ru: few / a few, little / a little
title.en: few or a few, little or a little
title.es: few o a few, little o a little

pattern.en: I have a few friends here.
pattern.ru: У меня здесь есть несколько друзей.

text.ru: Артикль a меняет настроение. a few / a little — «немного, но есть» (хорошо): a few friends, a little money. few / little без a — «мало, почти нет» (плохо): few people came. few, a few — с исчисляемыми (friends, days), little, a little — с неисчисляемыми (time, money, milk). В разговоре вместо few / little чаще not many / not much.
text.en: a few / a little = some, enough (positive). few / little = almost none (negative). few with countables, little with uncountables. Spoken English prefers not many / not much.
text.es: a few / a little = unos pocos, un poco (positivo); few / little = pocos, poco (negativo).

rule.formula: a few / a little — немного, хватает (+) · few / little — мало, почти нет (−)

exercises.en: I speak ___ Spanish, enough for a café.
exercises.ru: Я немного говорю по-испански — на кафе хватает.

exercises.en: Only ___ people came, so we cancelled the talk.
exercises.ru: Пришло мало людей, и мы отменили доклад.

exercises.en: Hurry up, we have very ___ time.
exercises.ru: Поторопись, у нас очень мало времени.

exercises.en: I have a few questions about the plan.
exercises.ru: У меня есть несколько вопросов по плану.

prompt.ru: Напишите, чего у вас немного (a few / a little) и чего мало (few / little).
prompt.en: Write what you have a little of and what you have little of.
prompt.es: Escribe de qué tienes un poco y de qué tienes poco.

exercises.template: I have a few … I have little …
exercises.sample: I have a few good friends. I have little free time.
